## Featured updates

[Image of a person flushing their dental unit waterlines using the A-dec Flush Dock over a sink]

#### How to Clean and Maintain Dental Unit Waterlines

Learn a clear, step-by-step approach to dental unit waterline (DUWL) maintenance—from choosing the
right water source to monitoring, shocking, and flushing treatments.

[Read article][128]
[A dental office employee looking at the Link AI inbox]

#### AI Dental Receptionist: Turn Missed Calls Into Revenue

Learn how AI dental receptionist software helps streamline scheduling, communication, and front desk
workflows.

[Read article][129]
[A-dec Impact logo]

#### A-dec Donates $1 Million to Dental Trade Alliance Foundation

A‑dec announced a transformative $1,000,000 endowment, in partnership with The Dental Trade Alliance
Foundation.

[Read press release][130]
[A-dec and Dentsply Sirona collaboration logos]

#### A-dec and Dentsply Sirona Expand Partnership

A‑dec and Dentsply Sirona expand their strategic partnership by integrating the Midwest Motor System
into A‑dec Pro delivery systems.

[Read press release][131]
[Two curved dark blue arrows containing the words A-dec Buyback Program]

#### A‑dec Buyback Program

Get cash back for your used A‑dec dental equipment.

[Learn more][132]
[Townie awards for A-dec dental equipment]

#### Thank you, Townie dentists

Since 2003, Dentaltown magazine's online community of dental professionals has consistently named
A‑dec products as the best across multiple categories.

[About the awards][133]
[3D visualization of A-dec dental equipment coming out of a phone]

#### 5 Tips and Tricks for Dream in 3D

From starting with a blank room or uploading photos of an existing space, to using AI-generated
color palettes, AR/VR visualization, and easy sharing tools, see how doctors can plan their
operatories with confidence.

[Read article][134]

## A-dec+ connected dentistry

Simple. Reliable. Intuitive. Imagine an updatable software platform that keeps your dental practice
ready for whatever lies ahead.

[Explore A-dec+][135]
[A-dec+ web and mobile application]

## Featured resources

Dream in 3D

Explore A‑dec dental equipment in 3D, and see products in your space with AR. Customize colors and
materials, and order free color samples.

[Explore Dream in 3D][136]

Order color samples

Order free A‑dec upholstery and cabinet color samples.

[Find your perfect color][137]

A‑dec buyback program

Get cash back for your A‑dec dental equipment—and get our best deal when you purchase new A‑dec
equipment at the same time.

[A-dec buyback program][138]

Customer stories

Hear why doctors choose A‑dec dental equipment to design healthy, comfortable, and high-quality
dental office experiences.

[Watch videos][139]

All Rights Reserved. ## Larry Cohen **CHIEF CUSTOMER ADVOCATE** Larry Cohen graduated from Wilkes College with a B.S. in Accounting in 1957 and Columbia University Graduate School of Business, earning an M.S. in Management and Finance, 1958. He served in the U. S. Army Reserve from 1958 through 1964. He is the second-generation owner of Benco Dental Company, which was founded by his father, Benjamin Cohen in 1930. Joining Benco Dental in 1959 as manager of the Tooth Department, in 1960, Larry became an outside sales rep, a position he enjoyed full time until 1972. Beginning that year, Larry began reducing his outside sales role and increasing his managerial duties, later becoming the president of Benco Dental from 1965 - 1996. Larry is the Founder of the American Dental Cooperative; Board, American Dental Trade Associate, plus Various ADTA committees. He sits on the Board of Wilkes University, Board of Visiting Nurses Association and the Board of Jewish Community Center. All Rights Reserved. ## Larry Cohen **CHIEF CUSTOMER ADVOCATE** Larry Cohen graduated from Wilkes College with a B.S. in Accounting in 1957 and Columbia University Graduate School of Business, earning an M.S. in Management and Finance, 1958. He served in the U. S. Army Reserve from 1958 through 1964. He is the second-generation owner of Benco Dental Company, which was founded by his father, Benjamin Cohen in 1930. Joining Benco Dental in 1959 as manager of the Tooth Department, in 1960, Larry became an outside sales rep, a position he enjoyed full time until 1972. Beginning that year, Larry began reducing his outside sales role and increasing his managerial duties, later becoming the president of Benco Dental from 1965 - 1996. Larry is the Founder of the American Dental Cooperative; Board, American Dental Trade Associate, plus Various ADTA committees. He sits on the Board of Wilkes University, Board of Visiting Nurses Association and the Board of Jewish Community Center. # DENTAL EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIES FROM A TRUSTED MANUFACTURER

At DENTALEZ, we have always understood what matters to dentists. Our dental products have been
carefully designed with the features you rely on most, from our revolutionary J-Chair to our smart
products with Aeras Intel.

# DENTAL EQUIPMENT AND SUPPLIES FROM A TRUSTED MANUFACTURER

At DENTALEZ, we have always understood what matters to dentists. Our dental products have been
carefully designed with the features you rely on most, from our revolutionary J-Chair to our smart
products with Aeras Intel.

## [TOTALOP ][159]

Now, we offer a first-of-its-kind solution, [TotalOp][160], an all-inclusive operatory subscription
service offering top-of-the-line chairs, compressors, vacuum, handpieces, and other leading dental
equipment, for one affordable and predictable monthly cost.

[][161]

## [DENTAL EQUIPMENT][162][][163]

Built on a foundation of premium engineering, the Forest 5400 balances durability, patient comfort,
and clinical functionality—at just the right price.

[][164]

## [DENTAL HANDPIECES ][165]

#### Star E900 Electric Handpiece System
#### Introducing an entirely ***new electric*** handpiece system from DENTALEZ.
#### *Smart Integration,
#### One Comprehensive System*

[][166]

## [DENTAL UTILITY ROOM EQUIPMENT ][167]

##  

Our Ramvac line of vacuums and compressors is renowned for its durability and reliablity; and we
continue to make them smaller, quieter, more powerful, more safe and more flexible.

[][168]

## [BE IN CONTROL WITH AERAS INTEL ][169]

DENTALEZ® smart products feature Aeras Intel that gives you the ability to collect data, share
information, and streamline your standard-of-care. This creates an ecosystem of patient care and
practice efficiency.

[][170]

## [DENTAL TEACHING AIDS, MODELS AND EQUIPMENT ][171]

We’re the industry standard in customizable teaching aids, helping prepare the next generations of
dental practitioners.

[][172]

We continue to innovate to answer the needs of our dentists and their patients. We manufacture and
supply the products and equipment that let you focus on what you do best - providing great dental
healthcare.

That’s peace of mind. Discover what DENTALEZ can do for you.

[][173]

#### [TRUSTED FOR OVER 100 YEARS][174]

Enjoy the proven performance of the brands you know and love, enhanced with cutting-edge technology
that helps you run an efficient, meticulous practice.

[LEARN MORE][175]
[][176]

#### [CUSTOMER CARE][177]

Our products are designed to provide exceptional value over the long term. That’s why they carry
some of the best warranties available, backed by responsive, expert customer service.

[YOU'RE COVERED][178]
[][179]

#### [A WELCOME COLLABORATION OF PRODUCTS AND KNOWLEDGE][180]

Dental Solutions & Technology (DSX), the sales organization from DENTALEZ, is filled with some of
the most knowledgeable sales representatives in the dental industry. Connect with your rep!

# Let Us Help You Choose a Plan

Take the guesswork out of picking a health plan. Answer a few questions to get a personalized
recommendation.

[ Get started . Opens in new window ][145]

New member? [Register now][146], or download the [Sydney Health app][147] to access your benefits,
ID card, pharmacy info, and more.

[Understand your care options][148] ahead of time so you can save time and money.

**Medicaid members:** New federal rules may affect your health coverage. [Learn more and stay
covered][149].

## Our Plans

#### Individual & Family Plans

We offer affordable health, dental, and vision coverage to fit your budget. Plus, you may qualify
for financial help to lower your health coverage costs.

Shop Plans
[ Overview ][150]

#### Medicare Plans

Find a Medicare plan that fits your healthcare needs and your budget. Compare plans available in
your area and apply today.

Shop Plans
[ Overview ][151]

#### Medicaid Plans

We offer low-cost coverage for children, adults, and families who qualify for state-sponsored
programs. Explore programs available in your state.

[ More About Medicaid Plans ][152]

#### Small Business Plans

Our small business plans offer a full range of health insurance options for groups with 2 to 50 or
100 employees, depending on your state.

[ More About Small Business Plans ][153]

## Let Us Help You Choose A Health Plan

Not sure what plan is right for you? We can help. Just answer a few questions.

[ Find your plan ][154]

## For Employers

We offer flexible group insurance plans for any size business. Employers can choose from a variety
of medical, pharmacy, dental, vision, life, and disability plans.

[ Learn More About Employer Plans ][155] [ Learn More ][156]

## Manage Your Health Plan All In One Place

Your online account is a powerful tool for managing every aspect of your health insurance plan.
Whether you need to check on a claim, pay a bill, or talk to a representative, you can easily access
all your member features.

[ Log In ][157] [Register ][158]
Submit & Track Claims

Quickly and easily submit out-of-network claims online.

Know Your Benefits

Review medical and pharmacy benefits for up to three years.

Make Payments

Pay outstanding doctor bills and track online or in-person payments. 

Manage Prescriptions

Price a medication, find a pharmacy, order auto refills, and more.

Member ID Card

Access your member ID card from our website or mobile app. 

Live Chat

Start a Live Chat with one of our knowledgeable representatives.

## Save Time With Live Chat

Find answers to all your questions with an Anthem representative in real time. Use our app, Sydney
Health, to start a Live Chat.

[ . Opens in new window Download Sydney Health ][159]

## Stay Healthy — Stay Informed

We’ve got the latest advice, tips, and news to help you get the most out of your benefits, find the
best healthcare, and stay healthy.

[ All Stories ][160]

## Your smile, our experts.

Your best smile is waiting at Bright Now! Dental! From cleanings to crowns, whitening to wisdom
teeth, we’ve got you covered with the comprehensive dental services you and your family need for a
lifetime of good oral health.
At Bright Now! Dental, you and your family can receive all the care you need at one convenient
location, saving you time, money, and hassle. We have all the state-of-the-art equipment and
technology to perform many procedures in-office as well as the experienced and highly-trained staff
to do them, making Bright Now! Dental a truly full-service provider.

## Bright Now! Dental is your affordable, comprehensive dental provider.

Good dental health is essential for good overall health, and at Bright Now! Dental, we care about
both! We offer all the dental and oral care services you need to get—and keep—your smile healthy.

Bright Now! Dental knows that taking care of your teeth takes a team effort. From the doctors to the
schedulers, from the front desk to the back billing, we’re all here to make sure your experience is
as seamless and stress-free as possible. We also understand that no two situations are the same, so
you can be confident that you’ll receive personalized, attentive, and considerate customer service,
no matter what your circumstances.

What makes Bright Now! Dental different is our commitment to high quality, affordable care for every
patient. Not only can we provide greater flexibility in service pricing for our patients, we can
also provide the time, technology, and resources our dentists need to deliver the individualized
care you deserve in a familiar, convenient, and comfortable setting.

### Right Here, Right Now

#### Open Evenings & Weekends

##### Here when you need us. Your neighborhood dentist.

Bright Now! Dental is here for you no matter when you need us or what you need us for. We know that
you’re busy, and sometimes you just can’t fit routine dental care into your 9-5 schedule. That’s why
we’re open on weekends and evenings at easy-to-find retail locations right in your neighborhood, so
you can get in, get out, and get on with your day without sacrificing quality care*.

[Read More][71]

We also provide exceptional emergency dental care services for dental emergencies and urgent dental
injuries. Bright Now! Dental accepts call-ahead and walk-in emergencies and we can see most patients
same-day.

Bright Now! Dental has more than 90 affiliated locations throughout Arizona, California, Colorado,
Florida, Indiana, Maryland, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and Washington, which means there
is one near you! Find your closest one here.

*individual office hours vary.

## Your smile, our experts.

Your best smile is waiting at Bright Now! Dental! From cleanings to crowns, whitening to wisdom
teeth, we’ve got you covered with the comprehensive dental services you and your family need for a
lifetime of good oral health.
At Bright Now! Dental, you and your family can receive all the care you need at one convenient
location, saving you time, money, and hassle. We have all the state-of-the-art equipment and
technology to perform many procedures in-office as well as the experienced and highly-trained staff
to do them, making Bright Now! Dental a truly full-service provider.

## Bright Now! Dental is your affordable, comprehensive dental provider.

Good dental health is essential for good overall health, and at Bright Now! Dental, we care about
both! We offer all the dental and oral care services you need to get—and keep—your smile healthy.

Bright Now! Dental knows that taking care of your teeth takes a team effort. From the doctors to the
schedulers, from the front desk to the back billing, we’re all here to make sure your experience is
as seamless and stress-free as possible. We also understand that no two situations are the same, so
you can be confident that you’ll receive personalized, attentive, and considerate customer service,
no matter what your circumstances.

What makes Bright Now! Dental different is our commitment to high quality, affordable care for every
patient. Not only can we provide greater flexibility in service pricing for our patients, we can
also provide the time, technology, and resources our dentists need to deliver the individualized
care you deserve in a familiar, convenient, and comfortable setting.

### Right Here, Right Now

#### Open Evenings & Weekends

##### Here when you need us. Your neighborhood dentist.

Bright Now! Dental is here for you no matter when you need us or what you need us for. We know that
you’re busy, and sometimes you just can’t fit routine dental care into your 9-5 schedule. That’s why
we’re open on weekends and evenings at easy-to-find retail locations right in your neighborhood, so
you can get in, get out, and get on with your day without sacrificing quality care*.

[Read More][71]

We also provide exceptional emergency dental care services for dental emergencies and urgent dental
injuries. Bright Now! Dental accepts call-ahead and walk-in emergencies and we can see most patients
same-day.

Bright Now! Dental has more than 90 affiliated locations throughout Arizona, California, Colorado,
Florida, Indiana, Maryland, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and Washington, which means there
is one near you! Find your closest one here.

Welcome To CTMI

# Leading Steam Turbine Manufacturers In India

﻿CTMI is one of the leading Steam Turbine Manufacturers In India situated in Hoskote which is 25 km
from Bangalore city. In the span of two decades, CTMI has manufactured and supplied a number of
powerful [ steam turbines ][37] of capacity up to 60MW to a range of industries that include
Bio-mass, Municipal Solid Waste based Independent power plants (IPPs), Captive power plants (CPPs),
and Co-generation plants in industries like Sugar, Paper, Textiles, Fertilizers and Steel.

## API Steam Turbines


CTMI is one of the few steam turbine manufacturers in India to offer steam turbines as per API
standards (Shell and Petronas variants/addendums for API as well).

[ Learn More ][39]
[settings_icon]

## Back Pressure Turbines


CTMI Offers Backpressure turbines in both Single & Multi Stage variants in the range of 5kW to 60 MW
which are often used in industrial plants, the turbine mainly serves as a reducing station between
the boiler and the process steam header.

[ Learn More ][40]
[back pressure turbine]
[sl_shape_layer]
[sl_line_shape]
[Steam turbines in south Korea]

## Condensing Turbines


CTMI Offers Condensing turbines in both Single & Multi Stage variants in the range of 100kW to 60
MW. The condensing turbines take high-pressure steam, expand it in turbine nozzles and blades, and
exhaust it to a condenser at lower than atmospheric pressure.

[ Learn More ][41]
[orange_brash_shape]

## Extraction Condensing Turbine


CTMI Offers Extraction condensing turbines in both Single & Multi Stage variants in the range of 2MW
to 60MW. The extraction condensing turbines are used when a constant pressure steam flow has to be
extracted for process purposes.

[ Learn More ][42]
[Extraction Condensing STG]
[settings_icon]
[sl_shape_layer]
[sl_line_shape]
[Chola Turbo Pressure System]

## PRV/PRDS replacement solutions


Make Free Electricity with CTMI Solutions for your existing low/medium pressure with
saturated/superheated steam. CTMI offers PRV replacements in the range of 5 kW to 30 MW, Requirement
for a process can be as high as 40 bar pressure.

[ Learn More ][43]
[orange_brash_shape]

## Forced lubrication system


The FLS package includes a hydraulically separated lubrication and Control Oil System, a hydraulic
fluid supply and conditioning system, and common control console in a single.

[ Learn More ][44]
[Forced Lubrication System]
[settings_icon]

## OUR SERVICES


CTMI provides 24/7 global services with dedicated and seasoned professional service, ensuring
absolute customer satisfaction. Our service centers are currently located in Bangalore, Pune, Delhi,
and Kolkata in India, as well as Bogota and Cali in Colombia, Brno in the Czech Republic, Perugia in
Italy, and Bangkok in Thailand.

standards (Shell and Petronas variants/addendums for API as well).

## Back Pressure Turbines


CTMI Offers Backpressure turbines in both Single & Multi Stage variants in the range of 5kW to 60 MW
which are often used in industrial plants, the turbine mainly serves as a reducing station between
the boiler and the process steam header.

[ Learn More ][40]

## Condensing Turbines


CTMI Offers Condensing turbines in both Single & Multi Stage variants in the range of 100kW to 60
MW. The condensing turbines take high-pressure steam, expand it in turbine nozzles and blades, and
exhaust it to a condenser at lower than atmospheric pressure.

[ Learn More ][41]
[orange_brash_shape]

## Extraction Condensing Turbine


CTMI Offers Extraction condensing turbines in both Single & Multi Stage variants in the range of 2MW
to 60MW. The extraction condensing turbines are used when a constant pressure steam flow has to be
extracted for process purposes.

[ Learn More ][42]

saturated/superheated steam. CTMI offers PRV replacements in the range of 5 kW to 30 MW, Requirement
for a process can be as high as 40 bar pressure.

[ Learn More ][43]

fluid supply and conditioning system, and common control console in a single.

# Partnering to Deliver Better Patient Care.

The innovative companies that are part of Envista help dental professionals deliver the best
possible patient care, every step of the way. We know that dental professionals do more than create
healthy, beautiful smiles—they create confidence. To achieve their goals, they need a champion. At
Envista, we're uniquely positioned to be this champion.

[ About us ][16]

### 2025 Annual Report

New Report

##### Just Released: Our 2025 Annual Report.

[**Learn more**][17]

Anchored by Envista’s value of Continuous Improvement, the Envista Business System (EBS) is our
foundation for success.

# Who We Are

Envista is a global family of more than 30 trusted dental brands, united by a shared purpose: to
partner with professionals to improve lives. Envista helps its partners deliver the best possible
patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

[ Watch video ][18] [ More about us ][19]

### Transforming the Dental Industry

The Envista portfolio of brands is dedicated to supporting, expanding, and improving how dental
professionals care for their patients. Focused on innovation and the future of the digital
landscape, we provide quality products and solutions for the dental office and beyond.

[ Learn more about Envista ][20]

### Side by Side

From digital consultation and modeling tools to superior equipment and surgical instruments, Envista
companies support dental professionals at every patient interaction, with increasingly integrated
digital workflows. Our comprehensive training and education programs offer career-spanning
professional growth.

[ Explore our businesses ][21]

## Specialty Products & Technologies

Envista's Specialty Products & Technologies division develops and manufactures a wide variety of
dental products, including dental implant systems, prosthetics, clear aligners, bracket and wires,
orthodontic and lab products, and the technology to match.

**[Learn more][22]**

Our brands in this segment:
* [
  ][23]
* [
  ][24]
* [
  ][25]
* [
  ][26]
* [
  ][27]
* [
  ][28]

## Equipment & Consumables

Envista's Equipment & Consumables segment develops and manufactures dental equipment and consumable
supplies used in dental offices, including digital imaging systems, dental practice equipment,
endodontic systems, restorative and impression materials, bonding agents and cements, and infection
prevention products.

**[Learn more][29]**

Our brands in this segment:
* [
  ][30]
* [
  ][31]
* [
  ][32]

  ][33]

### We champion creators of confidence.

Creating confidence is no small business. With deep industry roots and decades of world-class
experience, the people behind Envista know this well. Our companies help dental professionals
deliver the best possible patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

# Everllence - Moving big things to zero

[ Learn more about our new name ][162]

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

[Learn more about our Focus][163]

Future Technologies

## Explore our technologies for a net-zero future

> “We have the opportunity to decarbonize industries that are crucial for the world economy. That’s
> why we get out of bed every morning.”  

Dr Uwe Lauber, CEO Everllence

## What moves us forward

Career

### Working at Everllence

Are you looking to  leverage your existing knowledge and expertise to drive innovation? Or do you
want to  start your career with a global leader  in engineering and technology? Are you ready to
make a lasting impact as part of our team at Everllence and move big things to zero with us?

[ Learn more about our career opportunities
][172]
Digitalization

### Data is the future’s DNA

We at Everllence therefore enable you to increase the efficiency, reliability and maintenance of
your products. By introducing our digital key products CEON and PrimeServ Assist, we created a
comprehensive digital ecosystem that allows us to collect, combine and evaluate relevant data. This
databased ecosystem is our digital backbone and the base for new digital customer centric solutions
of the future.
[ Learn more about Digitalization at Everllence
][173]
[future-like visualization of a boat with digital components around it]

Discover Stories

## Gain deep insights into our projects

Discover Story

### From fertilizer to marine fuel

Ammonia is moving from concept to reality. In Japan, Everllence and its licensee Mitsui E&S are
testing the world's first commercial large-bore ME-LGIA engine, verifying consumption, emissions and
safety before the engine goes to sea on a bulk carrier. A decisive step toward carbon-free shipping.

[Read Story][174]

Discover Story

### Charting the IMO's course to net-zero

A one-year pause in the IMO Net-Zero Framework leaves the shipping industry without the rules it was
waiting for. Experts from Everllence and DNV explain what the framework still promises, why the
earliest entry into force is now 2028, and why the work on fuels, pricing and compliance must
continue regardless.

[Read Story][175]

# Everllence - Moving big things to zero

[ Learn more about our new name ][162]

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

[Learn more about our Focus][163]

### Data is the future’s DNA

We at Everllence therefore enable you to increase the efficiency, reliability and maintenance of
your products. By introducing our digital key products CEON and PrimeServ Assist, we created a

Discover Stories

## Gain deep insights into our projects

Discover Story

### From fertilizer to marine fuel

Ammonia is moving from concept to reality. In Japan, Everllence and its licensee Mitsui E&S are
testing the world's first commercial large-bore ME-LGIA engine, verifying consumption, emissions and
safety before the engine goes to sea on a bulk carrier. A decisive step toward carbon-free shipping.

[Read Story][174]

Discover Story

### Charting the IMO's course to net-zero

A one-year pause in the IMO Net-Zero Framework leaves the shipping industry without the rules it was
waiting for. Experts from Everllence and DNV explain what the framework still promises, why the
earliest entry into force is now 2028, and why the work on fuels, pricing and compliance must
continue regardless.

[Read Story][175]

## Your team has ideas,
## your agents have capabilities,
## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

## Millions build with HackMD's Markdown editor every day

Powering teams around the world, from next-generation startups to established institutions

Your workspace, where humans collaborate and agents can keep up

#### Write together, think together, ship together

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.
* [Live editing with multiple cursors][14]
* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[
Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.

See community stories][23]

docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.

* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

Teams are using HackMD's API to feed their agents context, automate note creation, and keep
documentation in sync.

## Your team has ideas,

## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

We provide a unique personal approach, day-to-day support, and all the tools you need to make your work accessible worldwide. ### Peer-review Our robust peer review ensures your work is suitable for publication and valuable to the scientific community. ### Online First On acceptance of your work, our early online publication provides access to the scientific community without delay. ### Open Access Your work will be permanently available online, free to download, share and read. ## 11,600+ Research Institutions Support Open Access at IntechOpen [View All Institutions][62] [[City University Of Hong Kong]][63] [[Iowa State University]][64] [[Fudan University]][65] [[Kings College]][66] [[Peking University]][67] [[Seoul]][68] [[Tsinghua University]][69] [[UMass Amherst]][70] [[Universidadde Buenos Aires]][71] [[Universidad Rey Juan Carlosde]][72] [[Universitatde Barcelona]][73] [[Universitéde Strasbourg]][74] [[University of Kansas]][75] [[CSIC]][76] [[University of Surrey]][77] 06 May 2026 ##### Reaching New Heights: IntechOpen Publishes its 8,000th Open Access Book IntechOpen is proud to announce a significant milestone for 2026: the publication of our 8,000th open access book. This milestone comes shortly after the 20th anniversary of the publication of our first OA book. [Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. This milestone reflects not only the company’s achievements but also the growing recognition of open access books as a vital model for academic publishing, contributing to the transformation of how knowledge is shared worldwide. [Read more][79] 16 October 2025 ##### IntechOpen Among First Publishers to Go Live with OA Switchboard Books Solution We are proud to announce that IntechOpen is among the first three publishers, alongside Cambridge University Press and University of Michigan Press, to go live with the OA Switchboard Books Solution. [Read more][80] 23 April 2025 ##### IntechOpen Marked 7,500th OA Book Release with 'Climate Policies,' Co-edited by Members of ##### Nobel Peace Prize-Winning IPCC Team Co-edited by Gary Yohe and Joel Smith, senior members of the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize-winning Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), this timely volume offers a comprehensive evaluation of contemporary climate policy strategies. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. #### [More about us »][41]

# Working With Us

The Services We Offer

At MedicAmins we offer services to limit your financial obligation and ensure quality when we:
* Buy your used equipment.
* Replace your old equipment with new if needed.
* Find new equipment for you, used or brand new.
* Help with the furnishing of the clinic.

Our aim while providing these services is to make the process as simple and cost-effective as
possible.

What You Will Need

From your first call or email, we are actively engaged in fulfilling your need. We will inquire
within the industry about available products to your liking making sure we do all contact between
dealers and suppliers streamlining your process.

Simply give us a[** call or email.**][42]

How It Works

A step by step guide on how we provide an end to end solution when buying or selling your medical
devices and supplies.

—————————–

**1) Contacting Us**

We are **available for calls Monday through Friday from 08:00 to 16:00 CET** at the following
number: *+45 28 18 58 16*

We have 24/7 email support with a quick response time of 24 hours or less. **Simply email us at**
[info@medicamins.com][43] or WhatsApp to *+45 28 18 58 16.*

—————————–

**2) Fulfillment Process**

After you have established an easily accessible line of contact with us we will discuss your needs
and the best possible solution going forward. 

This entails an extensive search to find a buyer or seller for your medical device and/or supplies.
We refine our search based on quality and cost-effective measures to ensure a smooth transition from
point A to point B. 

You will of course have the ability to contact us throughout this process. 

—————————–

**2) Successful Completion**

When the selling or purchasing of your medical devices or supplies is complete you’ll receive a
confirmation from us. 

Before, During, and After Transit

Liability for transporting the medical devices and/or supplies is handled through the most viable
and trustworthy carrier available at a per instance basis. 

**Before Transit**

Before the device(s) or supplies are shipped, MedicAmins ensures that the quality of the item meets
your standards. Warranties on the devices are discussed during the fulfillment process and aligns
with the manufacturer/supplier warranty. 

**During Transit**

Liability of safe transit to the destination is provided by MedicAmins. If an unforeseen
circumstance where to arise during transit your obligation is protected. 

**After Transit**

After a successful transit, your device is normally under warranty for 0-24 months, more depending
on the condition, device & manufacturer.

***Warranty and Liability details are dependent on individual needs, and MedicAmins
guarantees complete transparency throughout the entire selling process. *


### We will be a great assistant

We know about your hectic schedule. We also know that you need assistance in buying and selling
inventory to your clinic. To find a balance in your busy day, what’s on you is to contact us, and we
will manage the whole process of selling or buying your medical devices and clinic furniture

# Working With Us

The Services We Offer

At MedicAmins we offer services to limit your financial obligation and ensure quality when we:
* Buy your used equipment.
* Replace your old equipment with new if needed.
* Find new equipment for you, used or brand new.
* Help with the furnishing of the clinic.

Our aim while providing these services is to make the process as simple and cost-effective as
possible.

What You Will Need

From your first call or email, we are actively engaged in fulfilling your need. We will inquire
within the industry about available products to your liking making sure we do all contact between
dealers and suppliers streamlining your process.

Simply give us a[** call or email.**][42]

How It Works

A step by step guide on how we provide an end to end solution when buying or selling your medical
devices and supplies.

—————————–

**1) Contacting Us**

We are **available for calls Monday through Friday from 08:00 to 16:00 CET** at the following
number: *+45 28 18 58 16*

We have 24/7 email support with a quick response time of 24 hours or less. **Simply email us at**
[info@medicamins.com][43] or WhatsApp to *+45 28 18 58 16.*

—————————–

**2) Fulfillment Process**

After you have established an easily accessible line of contact with us we will discuss your needs
and the best possible solution going forward. 

This entails an extensive search to find a buyer or seller for your medical device and/or supplies.
We refine our search based on quality and cost-effective measures to ensure a smooth transition from
point A to point B. 

You will of course have the ability to contact us throughout this process. 

—————————–

**2) Successful Completion**

When the selling or purchasing of your medical devices or supplies is complete you’ll receive a
confirmation from us. 

Before, During, and After Transit

Liability for transporting the medical devices and/or supplies is handled through the most viable
and trustworthy carrier available at a per instance basis. 

**Before Transit**

Before the device(s) or supplies are shipped, MedicAmins ensures that the quality of the item meets
your standards. Warranties on the devices are discussed during the fulfillment process and aligns
with the manufacturer/supplier warranty. 

**During Transit**

Liability of safe transit to the destination is provided by MedicAmins. If an unforeseen
circumstance where to arise during transit your obligation is protected. 

**After Transit**

After a successful transit, your device is normally under warranty for 0-24 months, more depending
on the condition, device & manufacturer.

***Warranty and Liability details are dependent on individual needs, and MedicAmins
guarantees complete transparency throughout the entire selling process. *


### We will be a great assistant

We know about your hectic schedule. We also know that you need assistance in buying and selling
inventory to your clinic. To find a balance in your busy day, what’s on you is to contact us, and we
will manage the whole process of selling or buying your medical devices and clinic furniture

   MICRO LINE d.o.o., based in Trstenik, Serbia, was established in 1998. We specialize in the
production of **dental turbines and spare parts** for dental turbines, primarily **turbine rotors**.
Our company is one of the leading manufacturers of dental rotors in terms of assortment, quantity,
and quality. MICRO LINE d.o.o. holds all necessary certifications for the production of medical
equipment.

**What sets Microline Dental apart?**
* **Uncompromising Quality:** Every product that leaves our production facilities undergoes rigorous
  quality control to ensure it meets the highest global standards.
* **Innovation:** Our company continuously invests in research and development of new products and
  technologies to offer our clients the most advanced solutions.
* **Wide Product Range:** Microline Dental’s product range encompasses a broad spectrum of dental
  turbines and turbine rotors, tailored to meet the diverse needs of dentists.
* **Global Presence:** Microline Dental products are exported to numerous countries worldwide,
  affirming their superior quality and global competitiveness.

Jul 24, 2026 [

#### Janta Power Brings Rapidly Deployable Clean Energy to Fan Festivals and Beyond

][54]

**Janta Power**, a leading developer of patented three-dimensional solar tower energy systems,
announced a milestone for rapidly deployable infrastructure in support of one of the world’s largest
sporting events. At Fan Festival sites in Dallas and Houston, Janta’s innovative solar towers
generated power quietly and concurrently, demonstrating a new model for energy installations that
simplify sourcing logistics and align with compressed operational timelines.

[solar]The Dallas installation at Fair Park consists of four JP5K solar towers with integrated 28
kWh battery energy storage systems (BESS) and served as a temporary power source for the duration of
the Fan Festival. The East Downtown Houston tower and associated BESS served the Fan Festival and
will remain as a permanent fixture, purchased to benefit the community and provide power for public
amenities over a 25-year life span.

Both tower systems were deployed and fully operational within days, generating up to 275 KWh per day
to support event infrastructure for thousands of visitors throughout the Fan Festivals. In addition,
the towers feature a small footprint and visually appealing, fully functional body panels with
graphic designs representing the energetic spirit of the host cities.

"The World Cup is more than a sporting event – it's a proving ground for the future of energy
infrastructure," said Mohammed Njie, Founder and CEO of Janta Power. "By providing clean, quiet
power in days instead of months, we're demonstrating that renewable energy can be delivered where
it's needed most, without sacrificing speed, reliability, or performance. Whether it's powering a
global event, an AI data center, an airport, or a community, our mission is the same: to make clean,
affordable, and reliable energy quickly available wherever people need it.”

“Reliable power is a constant logistical consideration across festivals and large-scale events, so
solutions that simplify deployment can have a real operational impact,” said Skye Fabrizio,
Sustainability Manager at C3 Presents. “Janta’s towers were installed quickly, required minimal
space compared to standard solar installations, and provided quiet, reliable power directly on-site.
After seeing the technology in action, I see meaningful potential for its use across a much wider
range of live events and temporary installations."

Janta’s vertical solar towers are designed to generate approximately 50% more energy than
traditional flat-panel systems while using one-third of the land area, overcoming energy-density and
siting constraints that limit conventional solar. Each tower’s stacked vertical design and
integrated tracking system capture both low-angle morning and evening light, producing a dual-peak
power curve that better aligns with real energy demand.

The Fan Festival installations build on Janta’s growing commercial applications. Pilot programs are
underway with major global airports, including [Munich International
Airport][55], [Aena][56] (operator of over 70 airports worldwide), and [Dallas–Fort Worth
International Airport][57] (DFW), as part of the [Airports for Innovation][58] (A4I) initiative. The
momentum reflects a broader shift already under way: as power-hungry industries from AI to
telecommunications race to secure more capacity, the ability to stand up clean, quiet power sources
on limited square footage is a competitive advantage.

Jul 24, 2026 [

#### Factorial Secures First Commercial Aerospace Order for Advanced Battery Cells

][61]

**Factorial Energy Inc.** (Nasdaq: FAC) ("Factorial"), a leading American solid-state battery
innovator, announced its first commercial drone battery order. The order marks Factorial’s entry
into commercial aerospace applications.

The order marks Factorial’s first commercial order in the aerospace sector and follows successful
battery integration and drone flight testing. Factorial will supply high-energy-density
lithium-metal cells for integration into battery packs by a U.S.-based pack integrator, creating a
battery cell and pack supply chain designed to support demanding drone applications.

Factorial provides a foundation built to scale across the full breadth of physical AI — drones,
autonomous aviation, space, defense, and robotics — and to power a generation of autonomous machines
that must carry both their own intelligence and their own energy.

Unlike artificial intelligence operating inside centralized data centers, physical AI is embedded in
machines that operate in the real world. Drones, autonomous aircraft, mobile robots, spacecraft,
defense platforms, and other intelligent systems must carry both their own computing capability and
their own energy. These applications require more than batteries that simply store energy: they
require systems that deliver high power, manage heat, operate safely near people and sensitive
electronics, and maintain reliability under demanding environmental and mission conditions.

“We are thrilled about this commercial order from the aerospace sector, on the heels of our
successful integration and drone flight test that demonstrated a more than 30% increase in flight
range,” said Siyu Huang, CEO of Factorial. “It’s a validation that the same rigorous qualification
standards behind last year’s 1,200 km record drive and our first vehicle production program now
extend into an entirely new field. In only six months, we designed a new product, built integration
partnerships on three continents, completed flight testing, and secured a first purchase order. That
is the strategy working as designed. We are committed to building the foundational energy layer that
will underpin the next era of mobility and artificial intelligence. Humanity deserves better
batteries, and delivering them is our mission.”

As batteries become critical infrastructure for autonomous and intelligent systems over the next
decade, Factorial is positioning its technology to serve a broad and rapidly expanding marketplace.
According to a [March 2026 report][62] by the strategy consulting business unit of
PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC), the global Physical AI market is projected to reach approximately €430
billion by 2030, with significant upside potential as systems that operate in the real, physical
world continue to scale and mature.

### EDM solutions

We offer integral customised solutions for the manufacture of pieces using EDM technology or a
combination of processes. We do research and develop the best option for software, electrodes,
program generation, technology, special machines… and we are closely involved in the process
start-up.

We work with the client and analyse their needs in order to design customised machines. Each project
is unique which is why we develop exclusive manufacturing processes for each one and optimise their
productivity with more accurate results in their pieces.

[EDM solutions]

### TURBOMACHINERY

In the **Turbomachinery sector, EDM** allows high-precision machining of complex geometries in tough
materials like superalloys, reduces tool wear, minimizes thermal stress, and is versatile for both
prototyping and mass production.

### AUTOMOTION

In the **automotive sector, EDM** is essential for producing high-precision parts like engine
components, gears, and molds. It enables the machining of hard materials with complex geometries
while ensuring high durability and accuracy, which is critical for the efficiency and performance of
vehicles.

### MICROELECTRONICS

In the **microelectronics sector, EDM** is essential for its high precision in machining intricate
components like microchips and circuits, particularly in hard-to-machine materials. It enables
detailed cuts with minimal thermal damage, ensuring the integrity of delicate parts while supporting
both prototyping and mass production.

### MOULDING

In the **moulding sector, EDM** is crucial for producing highly precise and intricate mold cavities
in hard materials. It enables detailed features and complex designs, ensuring high-quality surface
finishes and accuracy, while also being effective for both custom prototyping and large-scale mold
production.

In the **Turbomachinery sector, EDM** allows high-precision machining of complex geometries in tough
materials like superalloys, reduces tool wear, minimizes thermal stress, and is versatile for both
prototyping and mass production.

### AUTOMOTION

In the **automotive sector, EDM** is essential for producing high-precision parts like engine
components, gears, and molds. It enables the machining of hard materials with complex geometries
while ensuring high durability and accuracy, which is critical for the efficiency and performance of
vehicles.

### MICROELECTRONICS

In the **microelectronics sector, EDM** is essential for its high precision in machining intricate
components like microchips and circuits, particularly in hard-to-machine materials. It enables
detailed cuts with minimal thermal damage, ensuring the integrity of delicate parts while supporting
both prototyping and mass production.

### MOULDING

in hard materials. It enables detailed features and complex designs, ensuring high-quality surface
finishes and accuracy, while also being effective for both custom prototyping and large-scale mold
production.

# Proceed.Fit's Mission of Affordable Healthcare for All

## Proceed.Fit: Your Gateway to Affordable Healthcare and Hospitalization Services

**At Proceed.Fit**, we are dedicated to making **affordable healthcare** accessible to everyone. As
a trusted healthcare technology platform, we ensure that people from all backgrounds can receive
high-quality medical care at **competitive rates**.

Our innovative platform connects users to top healthcare providers, offering cost-effective
**treatment options** without compromising quality. We understand the financial strain that comes
with medical care, which is why we prioritize **transparent pricing** and provide upfront cost
estimates for a wide range of treatments and procedures.

By partnering with leading hospitals, **fitness experts**, nutritionists, ambulance services,
diagnostic labs, and pharmacies, we secure **exclusive discounts** and offers for our users. Our
mission is to make healthcare more affordable and accessible, ensuring you receive the care you need
at a price that fits your budget.

**Discover a smarter way to manage your healthcare needs with Proceed.Fit.**

# Movers Company in Salt Lake City

Moving is an exciting time in a person’s life. You don’t want to let the logistics of the relocation
get in the way of enjoying this transitional period.

Whether you’re moving homes across town or moving a business across state lines, Two Man Movers &
Storage can help you through the process with our comprehensive, top-rated moving services in Salt
Lake City.

What started with two guys and a moving truck has turned into a thriving company with professional
movers dedicated to customer service. Our family values have never left us since the beginning. We
continue to offer the best moving and storage services in the Salt Lake City area.

Our family-owned and operated Salt Lake City moving company has been serving residents and
businesses in the Salt Lake City area since 1999. As a fully-licensed and bonded moving and storage
company, we offer top-quality residential, office, and international moves. We are a part of the
American Moving & Storage Association and are a partner of Bekins Moving.

Two Man Movers & Storage serves Salt Lake City and its surrounding metropolitan area, including
Sandy, Park City, Orem and Provo. We are highly active in the local community and frequently assist
in charity events around town, such as Move For Hunger, Toys For Tots and the Salt Lake City Pride
Parade.

We’re highly rated by the BBB and have [hundreds of 5-star reviews][97]. Our friendly customer
service and great value make us one of the top moving and storage companies in Salt Lake City. We
are proud to serve our customers with great service and take pride in our work.

Our Salt Lake City moving services experience begins with a free estimate done by one of our
highly-trained relocation specialists, either in-home or via video. Once a survey has been completed
and an estimate given, we can book your move and lock down a fair price. The relocation specialist
is your main point of contact throughout your move and is ready to answer all your questions.

Two Man storage facilities are state-of-the-art in terms of security and easy access. Your

Warehouse storage is a great option for clearing out the garage or holding onto extra files your
office doesn’t have space for but needs to keep in the long-term.

When you’re ready to pick up your items, give our warehouse a call. We’ll have your items ready for
you when you pull up to the warehouse.

While there are plenty of movers in the Salt Lake City area, not all of them offer the same services

When you need a specialty move completed in the Salt Lake City area, call Two Man. Our staff has the

At Two Man Movers & Storage, we’ve successfully completed all types of moves our founding in 1999.

With a staff of expert movers, all necessary supplies and resources ready to go and thoroughly

Our experience in the industry is second to none. Same with our customer service. A move with Two

## Did you know...?

Is There a Difference Between a Quote and Estimate?

Simply put, a quote is an exact price for a job set by the mover while an estimate is the mover’s
best guess as to how much it will cost, subject to change. A quote is set in stone, unless there is
a variation to your contract, which would include extra work or a change in the scope of a job.
There is no such thing as a binding estimate, your contractor can change the price for a variety of
reasons.

## Did you know...?

Is There a Difference Between a Quote and Estimate?

Simply put, a quote is an exact price for a job set by the mover while an estimate is the mover’s
best guess as to how much it will cost, subject to change. A quote is set in stone, unless there is
a variation to your contract, which would include extra work or a change in the scope of a job.
There is no such thing as a binding estimate, your contractor can change the price for a variety of
reasons.

## The global leader in sustainable energy solutions

We're on a mission to transform the global energy system. With a dedicated team of +35,000
employees, we work every day to shape a more sustainable future by designing, installing, and
maintaining wind energy projects worldwide.

We believe wind power will form the backbone of tomorrow’s energy system. That's why we're steadfast
in our commitment to solutions that drive the vital transition to renewable energy, with wind at the
core.

## Our sustainable energy solutions

[ [Onshore wind turbines] ][143]

##### Onshore wind turbines

We lead the onshore wind market with over 40 years of expertise, specialising in wind turbine design
and development.

[ Explore our onshore wind turbine solutions ][144]
[ [Offshore wind turbines] ][145]

##### Offshore wind turbines

We have an unrivalled track record of making wind work at sea, bringing offshore wind to life in
even the most challenging environments.

[ Explore our offshore wind turbine solutions ][146]
[ [Service] ][147]

##### Service

We maintain the world's largest wind turbine fleet, spanning over 56,000 turbines across 72
countries.

[ Explore our service solutions ][148]
[ [Development] ][149]

##### Development

We turn renewable energy visions into reality by developing high-quality renewable energy projects
with value.

[ Explore our project development solutions ][150]

## What makes a technology leader?

At Vestas, technology leadership means delivering lasting value. Through scalable, reliable, and
sustainable solutions, we deliver long-term value for customers and society - strengthening energy
systems and accelerating the transition to a more secure and sustainable future.

[ Discover more here ][151]

## The global leader in sustainable energy solutions

We're on a mission to transform the global energy system. With a dedicated team of +35,000
employees, we work every day to shape a more sustainable future by designing, installing, and
maintaining wind energy projects worldwide.

We believe wind power will form the backbone of tomorrow’s energy system. That's why we're steadfast
in our commitment to solutions that drive the vital transition to renewable energy, with wind at the
core.

## Our sustainable energy solutions

[ [Onshore wind turbines] ][143]

##### Onshore wind turbines

We lead the onshore wind market with over 40 years of expertise, specialising in wind turbine design
and development.

[ Explore our onshore wind turbine solutions ][144]

##### Offshore wind turbines

We have an unrivalled track record of making wind work at sea, bringing offshore wind to life in
even the most challenging environments.

[ Explore our offshore wind turbine solutions ][146]

We maintain the world's largest wind turbine fleet, spanning over 56,000 turbines across 72
countries.

We turn renewable energy visions into reality by developing high-quality renewable energy projects
with value.

At Vestas, technology leadership means delivering lasting value. Through scalable, reliable, and
sustainable solutions, we deliver long-term value for customers and society - strengthening energy
systems and accelerating the transition to a more secure and sustainable future.
